steps.title: 01-open: Open http://127.0.0.1:8069/ and sign in with username admin and password admin. Then create a new customer contact named exactly '{{runid}} Bench Customer' with the City field set to 'Benchville' (use the Contacts app or Sales > Customers > New). Save it and report the contact's name and city exactly as shown on the saved record page.

02-create: In the Sales app, create a new quotation for the customer '{{runid}} Bench Customer' (choose the customer from the autocomplete dropdown so it is properly set). Add exactly ONE order line: pick any product from the product catalogue via the product autocomplete dropdown, with quantity 3. Do NOT confirm the quotation yet — leave it as a draft quotation. Save it. Report: (a) the product name you chose, (b) the unit price the app filled in for that line, (c) the untaxed amount the app computes for the quotation, and (d) the quotation's reference name shown in the breadcrumb/title.

03-open: Open the existing draft quotation {{02-create.quotation_reference}} (for customer {{runid}} Bench Customer) in the Sales app. Add a SECOND order line: a product DIFFERENT from 'Acoustic Bloc Screens', chosen from the product autocomplete dropdown, with quantity 2. Keep the first line (Acoustic Bloc Screens, quantity 3) unchanged. Save the quotation (still draft, do not confirm). Report: (a) the product name of the new second line, (b) its unit price, and (c) the new untaxed amount the app computes for the whole quotation.

04-open: Open the existing draft quotation {{02-create.quotation_reference}} in the Sales app. Change the FIRST order line's quantity from 3 to 5 (the line for {{02-create.product_name}}). Leave the second line ({{03-open.line2_product}}, quantity 2) unchanged. Save the quotation (still draft, do not confirm). Report the new untaxed amount the app computes for the whole quotation, plus the per-line subtotals you see.
